title: Sir Edward Stafford (Paris) to Sir Francis Walsingham, 19 September 1586 (BL Harley MS 1582 ff. 74-75; DECODE R8503)

steps.what: Fetched the DECODE record, its API metadata and the 4 full-resolution images with the session cookie.
Read the pages: holograph clear despatch, Paris 19 Sept 1586, addressed on f. 75v to Walsingham; cipher only in four short runs on f. 74v, each glossed above.
CSP Foreign XXI pt 1, September 1586, 16-30 (BHO pp. 89-104): Stafford's SP letters of that month calendared, this Harley letter not; cryptiana Elizabethan page: no Stafford-Walsingham key.
Transcribed the four runs sign by sign with their glosses (Villequier; K. Navar; Kyll him and ye P. of Conde; D. Guise).
First try: the gloss 'villequier' covers only the six line-end signs; did not fit ten letters.
Run 1 read as one run across the line break with 6 as null: D x ◇ ◇ Δ Ɗ X ⊕ ꟻ ʃ = v i l l e q u i e r; run 3 M x ◇ h = k y l l with the same x and ◇ and 6 again null; 47/59/74 name codes.
Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): linked ciphertext.txt and plaintext.txt

outcome.method_basis: Each of the four short cipher runs on f. 74v has a contemporary decipherment written above it; the runs were transcribed sign by sign and the letter values, null and three name codes rebuilt from those glosses only to check them.
outcome.notes: Read at the time; all four runs re-read sign by sign and the letter values rebuilt (partial alphabet, three name codes; 6 was first taken as a null, corrected to e in NOTES.md of 22 Sept 2026, unreconciled with the run 1 sign string). DECODE recipient 'unknown' is Walsingham; place is Paris.

credits.note: interlinear decipherment of the four runs on f. 74v

texts.label: R8503, Paris, 19 Sept 1586: the four cipher runs
texts.summary: Sir Edward Stafford at Paris to Walsingham, 19 September 1586, a clear despatch on Mary Queen of Scots, Mendoza and Charles Paget; the four cipher runs name Villequier, the King of Navarre, the plan to kill him and the Prince of Condé, and the Duke of Guise's guard.
texts.note: The letter is otherwise in clear; only the cipher runs are transcribed.

reading_review.note: Rests on the four cipher runs re-read with the key of the glossed siblings (plaintext.txt): villequier / king of navarre / kyll him and the prince of conde / duke of guise. Short runs inside a clear despatch; each reads as sense in its clear sentence (the plan to kill Navarre and Condé, Guise's guard), no holes.

prior.where: Interlinear decipherment on f. 74v; not in CSP Foreign XXI pt 1 (Harley MS, outside the State Papers)

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up the coding agent with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue.
